payload.title: Captured Reference text is unavailable to knowledge queries
payload.description:
Observed on Machines on Machines, 2026-11-06: ten accepted References had no captureState after `references create-from-catalog`. Their source texts were captured through the signed-in `correctReferenceCapture` action, and all ten now have `captureState=full`. The active `curation-edit-...-text` ModelAttachment for each was found by the owner index and successfully downloaded. The source text was captured by an AI agent and labeled as not independently completeness-checked.

A subsequent `papyrus --site newsroom.machines-on-machines.anth.us knowledge query --query "How can humans oversee increasingly capable AI agents and verify their actions?" --profile researcher --format both --max-tokens 600 --top-k 10 --depth 1` returns ten matches but zero evidence passages, `sourceTextMode=metadata` and warnings that no extracted text attachment exists for the first five. The knowledge engine currently selects `ReferenceAttachment` role `extracted_text`; `correctReferenceCapture` stores text as a `ModelAttachment` instead. See docs/reference-curation-pipeline.md “Not done here.” Investigate using the current curated text in knowledge queries and indexing, respecting correction precedence and authorization; don't claim this is an indexing delay without evidence. It should work for signed-in operators and the shared MCP interface.

Additional reproducible symptom: `AttachmentStore.read_text` on a captured Reference returned no text when it constructed a ModelAttachment ID locally, but finding the active attachment through `listModelAttachmentsByOwnerRoleAndSortKey` and passing that record to `download_attachment_buffer` returned the full text. Check canonical attachment ID generation between deployed writer and client; no root cause has been proven.

Feature: Captured Reference text can be used for research
  Scenario: A captured Reference supplies evidence to knowledge search
    Given an accepted Reference has captured source text and captureState full
    When a researcher queries the relevant topic
    Then the knowledge query can read evidence passages from that current captured text
    And reports any extraction or permission problem honestly

  Scenario: A corrected capture supersedes an older one
    Given an editor replaces an earlier captured text
    When a researcher queries that Reference
    Then the current correction takes precedence and remains attributed

  Scenario: The CLI can read the current captured attachment
    Given a captured Reference with an active text attachment
    When the signed-in CLI reads the current text
    Then the content is retrieved using the same identifier or lookup as the writer.
